notes.pro_rata_share: Initially 63.54% (§1.1(l)). First Amendment changes to 100% after Expansion Space Commencement Date. LLM may extract either value.
notes.cap_type: 5% year-over-year cap on controllable expenses only (§4.3): 'Common Area Expenses (excluding non-controllable items such as utilities & security) in any year shall not be increased by more than five percent (5%) over the prior year's Common Area Expenses'. Non-controllable items are uncapped.
notes.admin_fee_percent: No add-on admin fee after the CAM subtotal is stated.
notes.management_fee_percentage: §23.5: 'the management fees which Landlord pays for the management of the Center in an amount not to exceed fifteen percent (15%) of the total of all other Common Area Expenses.' This is a cap on a management-fee component of Common Area Expenses, not a separate admin surcharge.
notes.excluded_pools: Capital is NOT excluded — it is included but amortized per GAAP (§23.5): 'to the extent that any item comprising a portion of Common Area Expenses is a capital expenditure, then such item shall be amortized over its useful life in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.' LLM may reasonably extract [] or ['capital'].
notes.accounting_basis: Not explicitly stated in lease. GAAP reference in §23.5 is for capital amortization method only, not cash vs accrual basis.
notes.premises: Original premises: 26,905 sqft (§1.1(g)). After First Amendment expansion: 42,342 sqft (all leasable space). Note: GL/rent-roll CSV fixtures use synthetic values for parser format testing.
notes.rent: Original premises: $15.00 psf/yr (months 1-60), $16.00 psf/yr (months 61-120) per §1.1(j). Post-expansion: same rates applied to 42,342 sqft.
